title: Leia Organa
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Leia Organa continued to rise within the ranks of the Rebel Alliance. With Alderaan and the Senate both gone, the facade of diplomacy was no longer relevant. Leia's role shifted from political to militaristic as she guided soldiers, helped boost morale, and developed battle plans she often had a hand in executing. Boasting the title of General prior to the Battle of Endor, Leia had no qualms about hitting the ground and joining the fight.
